title: Red Hat Security Advisory: openvswitch3.6 security update
description: A use-after-unmap vulnerability exists in the dpdk VDUSE handler of Open vSwitch 3.6, where vring pointers are not invalidated when the IOTLB is invalidated. This flaw can lead to memory corruption. Red Hat has issued a security update for Open vSwitch 3.6 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux Fast Datapath 10 to address this issue.
